chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) on clay/flint, averaging 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail. Organic since 2019; biodynamic certification possible 2026. Exports are 41% (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60mg/L. Two past failures: a 2022 tank 4 controller drift cost €11,000 (now double probes, pre-harvest calibration); a 2023 label error recalled 900 bottles (proofs need two signatures). Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates from three mornings of sugar/acidity data; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Open: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no costing); eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided.
